name: Iron Bisglycinate
effects: Chelated form with significantly better GI tolerability than ferrous sulfate
Hemoglobin and myoglobin synthesis — oxygen transport
Deficiency most common in menstruating women, vegetarians, endurance athletes
Bisglycinate has ~4x less GI side effects than ferrous sulfate at equal doses
Iron overload is dangerous — only supplement with confirmed deficiency (serum ferritin, TIBC)
Vitamin C enhances absorption; calcium, coffee, tea, and phytates inhibit absorption
